Jingle Bells

An arrangement model writes the accompaniment for this lead sheet. While it generates, we add a direction to its internal activations for one instrument in two bars. The direction found with a sparse autoencoder makes the clarinet play denser there; a random direction of the same size leaves it almost unchanged.
